scope.train_core_algorithm: Released HIMActorCritic, HIMPPO and HIM estimator
scope.training_difference: Saved manifests differ only by added leg_contacts reward weight -0.1; other checked training controls match
scope.fidelity_note: The released Go1 collision reward weight is zero; contact branch adds a Go2 adaptation
scope.selection: Apply the existing casewise 95% traversal gate, then assess motion/contact/tracking tradeoffs; no criterion is relaxed
scope.single_training_seed_limit: One common checkpoint and training seed cannot establish effects across seeds, broad causality or arbitrary stairs. This is evidence for one matched training realization.

faithful.geometry_reference: relative to scene.env_origins; positive x travel
faithful.curriculum_promotion: directed goal progress and actual stair_goal_reached, excluding genuine terminations
faithful.curriculum_diagnostics_scope: current training reset rows by ascent/descent; zero fraction with reset_count=0 means no samples; not independent held-out validation

contact.geometry_reference: relative to scene.env_origins; positive x travel
contact.curriculum_promotion: directed goal progress and actual stair_goal_reached, excluding genuine terminations
contact.curriculum_diagnostics_scope: current training reset rows by ascent/descent; zero fraction with reset_count=0 means no samples; not independent held-out validation

contact.scope: CUDA training and export; locomotion requires separate evaluation

faithful.scope: CUDA training and export; locomotion requires separate evaluation

contact.note: Explicit DCMotor gains live on the actuator; zero solver joint_stiffness is not a PD readback

training_provenance_and_matching.scope: Matched training manifests and common checkpoint, with one training seed 1. Manifests do not establish equality of runtime trajectories, per-environment RNG state or nondeterministic GPU effects.

contact_sampling.history_count_window_definition: history_length times sample interval; distinct from oldest sample age
contact_sampling.cadence_evidence: inferred from instantiated config and scene stepping; runtime sensor timestamps were not measured
contact_sampling.history_limit: history peaks can miss contacts outside the retained samples; reset rows start with zero history
contact_sampling.current_sample_scope: latest sensor force at the policy boundary before auto-reset; no substep duration inference
contact_sampling.force_measure: world-frame vector norm of net normal force, including riser normals; no tangential friction force
contact_sampling.slip_velocity_measure: foot-link world-horizontal speed at the policy boundary; not contact-point tangential slip
contact_sampling.legacy_results: reports without this metadata keep their original sampling semantics and cannot be assumed to use physics-step history

smoothness_interpretation: Smoothness is unverified. No pause flag only means maximum flight pause <=1 s. Current/history contact fractions do not measure duration or damage; inspect action, jerk, forces and tracking together.
measurement_exposure: All source first episodes include failures and stop at completion/failure; ordinary motion metrics exclude the first second. Lower contact/action on failed or shortened episodes does not establish smoother competent traversal.

candidate_interpretation.selection_scope: Reused 24-case tuning/regression matrix, not independent final validation
candidate_interpretation.recommendation: Keep contact620 as the contact-branch candidate; compare all gate-qualified faithful candidates using independent final cases and seeds, rather than choosing by checkpoint age or a scalar score.
candidate_interpretation.single_training_seed_limit: This matched realization uses one common checkpoint and training seed 1; evaluation reset seeds are not independent training repetitions.
